Definition: a Jishmaelite or descendant of Jishmael
BiblicalUsage: An Ishmaelite is a descendant of Ishmael, named among the traders who bought Joseph and the men who served David. In Genesis 37:25, a company of Ishmeelites came from Gilead with their camels bearing spicery and balm and myrrh. The fuller story is told on the Ishmael profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Ishmaelite matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
